clxPolicy.fibComplexMeaning: The last save was incremental; it does not select the text algorithm.
clxPolicy.recordOrder: Zero or more Prc records followed by exactly one final Pcdt with no trailing bytes.
clxPolicy.prcLength: Signed Int16 from 0 through 0x3FA2, containing a whole GrpPrl.
clxPolicy.plcPcdLength: 4 + 12*n bytes for n greater than zero.
clxPolicy.cpPolicy: Unsigned 32-bit values, first zero, strictly ascending, unique and below 0x7FFFFFFF.
clxPolicy.physicalOrderPolicy: Decode in CP order. FC ranges may be discontiguous, descending, shared or overlapping when each referenced range is valid.
clxPolicy.quickSavePolicy: The current FIB, selected Table stream and current CLX are authoritative; stale unreferenced bytes are never fallback text.

piecePolicy.bounds: Checked complete byte ranges must fit both WordDocument stream length and FibRgLw97.cbMac.
piecePolicy.noParagraphLastBit: When Pcd.fNoParaLast is one, the referenced text range must contain no U+000D paragraph mark.
piecePolicy.unicodePolicy: UTF-16LE code-unit CP accounting; valid pairs consume two CPs. Each isolated surrogate projects U+FFFD with exact corruption evidence.

compressedDefaultMapping: Every other byte maps to the same-valued Unicode code point; no Windows code page, DBCS, FIB language or font charset selects another decoder.

partPolicy.reserved3: Must be zero and is never a Macro part.
partPolicy.main: Must be non-empty and end with U+000D.
partPolicy.specializedTail: If any specialized part is non-empty, exactly one U+000D follows the last non-empty part outside all parts; otherwise no outside-part CP exists.
partPolicy.headerStories: First six are footnote/endnote separator, continuation-separator and continuation-notice stories; then six header/footer kinds per section. Non-empty stories have an excluded U+000D guard.
partPolicy.autoText: A bounded secondary FIB has its own CLX; SttbfGlsy and PlcfGlsy order named ranges after primary document evidence.

quickSavePolicy.authoritativeState: The current FIB, selected Table stream and current CLX only.

reviewProjection.unknownSpecialControl: Retain a typed unsupported token, emit no literal control byte, and prevent Complete.
reviewProjection.fieldPolicy: Never evaluate. Emit stored result text as primary review text; retain instruction text as non-primary evidence. Missing stored result is not manufactured.
reviewProjection.logicalOrder: Main, anchored footnotes, section-associated headers/footers, anchored comments, anchored endnotes, anchored main textboxes, header textboxes, then named AutoText ranges. Unanchored decoded text is retained as partial evidence, never silently dropped.
reviewProjection.bidiPolicy: Preserve logical CP order; never perform visual reordering.
reviewProjection.symbolPolicy: Use only CSymbolOperand.xchar and retain its font index; no font glyph rendering or guessed substitution.
reviewProjection.unsubstantiatedControls: U+001E and U+001F are unsupported until conformance or differential evidence establishes semantics.
